_comment: No `crons` entry: the Vercel account this deploys under is on the Hobby plan, which only permits once-daily cron jobs — incompatible with send-scheduled needing to run every few minutes. /api/cron/send-scheduled and /api/cron/run-rules still exist and are still auth-gated by CRON_SECRET; nothing currently calls them. Wire up an external scheduler (GitHub Actions on a schedule, cron-job.org, Supabase pg_cron via net.http_post, or upgrading this Vercel project to Pro and restoring a `crons` block here) to actually fire scheduled sends and automation rules. See docs/GO-LIVE.md.
